development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code 2.1.319 (inferred from bundled-skills path) as a subagent of a parent session (subagent type not-exportable), Windows 11, model claude-opus-5-5, default settings. All code, fixtures, tests and docs were agent-generated. Python 3.12.4, Pillow 12.0.0, Node 24.14.1 (syntax check only).

plugins_and_extensions.notes: Built-in Claude Code skill 'claude-api' loaded once to confirm model ID and image request shape. Built-in advisor review used twice (before coding, before handback). Skill-recommended refusal fallbacks parameter not enabled; refusals/truncation become failed extractions. No plugins installed for this exercise.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Gemini (used for real): REST generateContent via urllib, model gemini-3.5-flash-lite (MODEL_NAME overrides), responseMimeType application/json for extraction, other settings default, >=30 s between requests, 429/503 retried max 3 times. 16 live requests in one follow-up run; real responses in data/model_responses/live-gemini/, outputs in data/real-run/. Claude: Anthropic Messages API, claude-opus-5-5, max_tokens 16000 (thinking is always on and shares it), default thinking/effort, no temperature - never called for real. Default runs replay SIMULATED responses from data/model_responses/simulated/.

skills.notes: No custom skills. The starter pack's generate-assignment-data SKILL.md was read and followed manually for fixtures, not installed.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: A coordinating Claude Code session delegated the work to a built-in general-purpose subagent (no custom agent definition, no CLAUDE.md). The full instructions it received are saved in ai-workflow/prompts/; the API key is redacted there.

prompts_and_rules.notes: EXTRACTION_PROMPT and NOTE_PROMPT live in code. The domain rules are data/seed/domain.md (copied unchanged).

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: Claude Code default tools; no MCP server used for this exercise.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Env names: MODEL_API_KEY, MODEL_PROVIDER, MODEL_NAME. The Gemini key was supplied by the coordinating session and passed only as a command environment variable; it is not in any file (grep for its prefix: 0 hits). Session permissions came from the parent Claude Code session (user-level, not copied: not-exportable).
